candidates.source_name: AJPES JOLP – Javna objava letnih poročil (public disclosure of annual reports)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory single point where every Slovenian company, cooperative, bank, insurer and sole trader files its annual report; free full-text/PDF access to the last five business years. This is the canonical artefact store for A1 annual reports and financial statements for banks, payment institutions and their POS/IT suppliers alike.
candidates.legal_status: official government agency (AJPES), public information regime
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted entity-by-entity retrieval keyed by matična številka (registration number) obtained from ePRS/OPSI; respect the documented daily cap (search results indicate ~20 entities per user per day) and prefer the paid FI-PO / ponovna uporaba bulk channel for scale.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language seed query + snowball from AJPES annual-report section
queries_used: AJPES JOLP javna objava letnih poročil banka
candidates.observed_blocker: AJPES documentation describes a daily quota per user account on JOLP lookups (not observed directly by fetch)

candidates.source_name: AJPES – Letna in druga poročila: seznam poročil (list of report types by entity class)
candidates.why_relevant: Enumerates which report types (audited annual report, consolidated report, bank/insurer specific forms) are publicly disclosed for which legal form. Essential for knowing what artefact to expect for a bank vs a d.o.o. payments vendor before designing collection.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off documentation scrape; re-check annually.
queries_used: AJPES JOLP javna objava letnih poročil banka

candidates.source_name: AJPES – Koledar javne objave letnih poročil (disclosure calendar)
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes the dates on which each tranche of annual reports becomes public (e.g. mass disclosure for FY2025 reported in early August 2026). Lets a collector schedule crawls instead of polling blindly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency page monitor (monthly) to drive the annual-report crawl scheduler.
queries_used: AJPES JOLP javna objava letnih poročil banka

candidates.source_name: AJPES ePRS – Poslovni register Slovenije (Business Register search, incl. by SKD activity)
candidates.why_relevant: Central register of all Slovenian legal entities; basic search supports filtering by SKD (NACE) main activity code and institutional sector, which is exactly how one enumerates the banking (64.19), holding/other financial (64/65/66.19) and payment-services universe before pulling their filings.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query by SKD code to build the target-entity list (matična št., davčna št., name, address), then join to JOLP for the annual reports; consider the paid web-service channel for bulk.
queries_used: AJPES poslovni register iskanje po dejavnosti SKD 64.19 ePRS

candidates.source_name: AJPES – Ponovna uporaba podatkov PRS / web services for developers
candidates.why_relevant: Documents the machine channels (wsPRS and related web services) for reusing business-register data in a client's own system — the legitimate, contractual route to bulk company data instead of scraping ePRS.
candidates.access_status: documentation free; data reuse is paid/contractual
candidates.legal_status: re-use of public sector information under AJPES tariff
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read docs, then negotiate a data-reuse contract if bulk company data is needed; do not scrape as a substitute.
queries_used: AJPES ponovna uporaba podatkov FI-PO letna poročila spletni servis API

candidates.source_name: AJPES FI-PO / proFI-PO – financial data and indicators from annual reports (re-use channel)
candidates.why_relevant: Structured, field-level financial data extracted from filed annual reports (plus unpaid-liability flags), available as a web service or bulk delivery. Turns the PDF annual-report corpus into machine-readable financials for banks and payments vendors — the highest-leverage A1 asset if budget allows.
candidates.legal_status: licensed re-use of public sector information; pricing in AJPES Cenik storitev
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Commercial subscription to proFI-PO web service or periodic bulk delivery; check Cenik storitev for the current tariff.
queries_used: AJPES ponovna uporaba podatkov FI-PO letna poročila spletni servis API

candidates.source_name: AJPES eObjave – official electronic announcements (court/business register entries, insolvency, company notices)
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes registration decisions, founding/amendment documents, statutory company announcements and insolvency proceedings. Reveals ownership changes, capital increases, mergers, new payment-services subsidiaries and distress events for banks' suppliers — corporate-event intelligence that never appears in an annual report.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled search by entity name / matična številka for the tracked entity list; also periodic sweep of insolvency notices for payments-sector NACE codes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language seed query on the court register
queries_used: sodni register Slovenija eObjave AJPES objave subjektov vpisa

candidates.source_name: Sodni register / court register document collection via AJPES
candidates.why_relevant: Since Feb 2008 the underlying documents behind register entries (articles of association, court decisions, filed deeds) are published. Gives primary evidence of corporate structure and shareholder changes for Slovenian banks and fintech/payment entities.
candidates.legal_status: public book (javna knjiga) under Slovenian law
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Entity-keyed pull on demand when a corporate event is flagged in eObjave.
queries_used: sodni register Slovenija eObjave AJPES objave subjektov vpisa

candidates.source_name: OPSI – Poslovni register Slovenije open dataset (podatki.gov.si)
candidates.why_relevant: Free, licence-clean bulk extract of PRS basic data (registration number, full name, address, legal form, registering body), refreshed roughly twice monthly in XML/CSV. The cheapest legitimate way to build and refresh the Slovenian entity master list that everything else joins to.
candidates.legal_status: national open data portal, open licence
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bi-monthly scheduled download of the resource files; diff against previous snapshot to detect new registrations.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language open-data query, snowballed from ePRS page
queries_used: podatki.gov.si poslovni register Slovenije odprti podatki AJPES dataset

candidates.source_name: SEOnet – Ljubljana Stock Exchange regulated-information feed (Slovene)
candidates.why_relevant: The mandated publication venue for regulated information of LJSE-listed issuers — NLB, other financial issuers and listed suppliers post annual/interim reports, earnings, inside information and financial-calendar items here first. Highest-timeliness A1 artefact stream in Slovenia.
candidates.legal_status: exchange-operated statutory disclosure system under ZTFI-1
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily crawl of the announcement list plus per-issuer archive pages; attach PDF payloads. Check for an RSS/e-mail alert channel on the portal before falling back to HTML polling.
queries_used: SEOnet Ljubljanska borza objave nadzorovanih informacij NLB
SEOnet RSS obvestila naročnina izdajatelj objave arhiv seonet.ljse.si

candidates.source_name: SEOnet English interface (Ljubljana Stock Exchange announcements, EN)
candidates.why_relevant: Many issuers post an English version of the same regulated announcement; useful for downstream NLP and for cross-checking Slovene originals without translation loss on numbers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl in parallel with the Slovene feed; pair announcements by doc_id where possible (observed pattern: default_en.aspx?doc_id=NNNNN&language=en).
candidates.discovered_via_method: English seed query + observed URL pattern in results
queries_used: ljse.si finančni koledar izdajatelji seznam delnice Ljubljana Stock Exchange issuers

candidates.source_name: Ljubljana Stock Exchange – List of Issuers
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative roster of every issuer on the exchange market with links to their regulated information — the seed list for which Slovenian financial-sector companies have continuous disclosure obligations at all.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly refresh of the issuer list; map each issuer to its ISIN and SEOnet archive URL.
candidates.discovered_via_method: English seed query, snowballed to Slovene instrument pages
queries_used: ljse.si finančni koledar izdajatelji seznam delnice Ljubljana Stock Exchange issuers

candidates.source_name: Ljubljanska borza – Finančni koledar (issuer financial calendar)
candidates.why_relevant: Forward calendar of issuer results dates, general meetings and dividend events. Lets collection be scheduled ahead of earnings releases rather than discovered after the fact. Exact deep-link URL not confirmed in this pass — enter from the LJSE homepage/sitemap.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the calendar page via https://ljse.si/en/sitemap/959, then poll monthly.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search snippet referencing 'Finančni koledar za leto 2026'; deep link not confirmed
queries_used: ljse.si finančni koledar izdajatelji seznam delnice Ljubljana Stock Exchange issuers

candidates.source_name: LJSE INFO HRAMBA – officially appointed mechanism (OAM) for storing regulated information
candidates.why_relevant: The storage mechanism behind SEOnet: defines how regulated information is captured and archived and how third parties access it. Reading the rules tells a collector what the guaranteed retention, format and metadata are — and whether the OAM, not SEOnet, is the better long-term archive endpoint.
candidates.legal_status: exchange rules implementing ZTFI-1 / Transparency Directive
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off document read to design the ingestion contract; re-check on rule updates.
queries_used: SEOnet Ljubljanska borza objave nadzorovanih informacij NLB
SEOnet RSS obvestila naročnina izdajatelj objave arhiv seonet.ljse.si

candidates.source_name: ATVP – Registri (Securities Market Agency registers: prospectuses, issuer reports)
candidates.why_relevant: The securities regulator maintains registers of approved prospectuses and of issuers' audited annual and semi-annual reports / regulated-information filings. Prospectuses are dense primary sources on bank funding, ownership and business model that never appear in AJPES.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly sweep of the prospectus register and the public-companies (javne družbe) list; download new prospectus PDFs.
queries_used: ATVP register prospektov nadzorovane informacije izdajatelji Agencija za trg vrednostnih papirjev

candidates.source_name: OAM.si – publicly accessible register of issuers' audited annual and semi-annual reports
candidates.why_relevant: ATVP documentation states the register of issuers' audited annual reports, semi-annual reports and regulated-information reports is publicly accessible free of charge at www.oam.si. If it functions as described it is a second, regulator-side archive of exactly the A1 artefacts, complementary to SEOnet.
candidates.access_status: stated free_public; not directly verified in this pass
candidates.legal_status: officially appointed mechanism under Transparency Directive / ZTFI-1
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manually confirm the live endpoint and its search/export capability, then decide whether it or SEOnet is the primary ingestion point.
candidates.discovered_via_method: referenced inside ATVP register description (not fetched)
queries_used: ATVP register prospektov nadzorovane informacije izdajatelji Agencija za trg vrednostnih papirjev
candidates.observed_blocker: URL inferred from ATVP's textual reference to 'www.oam.si'; liveness and exact scheme unconfirmed

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register subjektov nadzora (register of supervised entities)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative roster of banks, savings banks, EEA branches, payment institutions, e-money issuers, account information service providers, exempt payment institutions, payment system operators and NPL servicers active in Slovenia. This is the definitive name list to feed into AJPES JOLP and SEOnet crawls — without it, the payments universe is guesswork.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly snapshot of each register sub-list; diff to catch new licences/passporting entrants; join names to PRS matična številka.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij seznam bank objave
local_language_terms_used: ponudniki storitev zagotavljanja informacij o računih

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Seznam notifikacij plačilnih institucij (PSD2 passporting notifications, PDF catalogue)
candidates.why_relevant: Lists foreign payment institutions notified to operate in Slovenia — the inbound-competition view that no domestic filing register captures. Directly relevant to sizing the payments market and spotting new entrants.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic PDF fetch + table extraction; diff versions to detect new notifications.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from Banka Slovenije register query
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij seznam bank objave

candidates.source_name: e-Justice portal – Slovenia business registers page (BRIS entry point)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-level description of and gateway to the Slovenian register, including the BRIS interconnection. Useful for cross-border lookups of Slovenian entities and for confirming which register is legally authoritative for which document type.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Reference reading; use BRIS search for cross-border entity resolution.

candidates.source_name: Issuer-side SEOnet mirrors (e.g. NLB investor announcements page)
candidates.why_relevant: Listed issuers republish their SEOnet filings on their own IR pages, often with cleaner HTML, English versions and longer archives than the exchange feed. A useful redundancy layer if SEOnet crawling is rate-limited or restructured.
candidates.legal_status: company website; terms of use apply
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Per-issuer IR page crawl as a fallback/enrichment to the SEOnet feed; also seen for other issuers (e.g. Luka Koper 'SEOnet announcements').

negative_findings.description: No public, documented REST/JSON API or RSS feed for SEOnet announcements was found in this pass. Searches in Slovene for an RSS/subscription channel returned only issuer instructions and unrelated RSS-software results.
negative_findings.result_summary: SEOnet appears to be an ASPX web application (default.aspx / default_en.aspx?doc_id=NNNNN) with an announcement archive; ingestion will likely require HTML crawling unless an undocumented feed exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines whether A1 disclosure ingestion for Slovenia is a cheap feed subscription or a maintained scraper with breakage risk.

negative_findings.description: AJPES JOLP free public access is documented as rate-limited (search-result text describes a daily cap of around 20 business entities per user account) and free viewing covers only the last five business years.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk annual-report harvesting via the free JOLP interface is not viable at portfolio scale; historical depth beyond five years reportedly requires AJPES offices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Forces either a paid FI-PO/ponovna-uporaba contract or a narrowly targeted entity list; naive crawling would breach the service and produce gaps.

negative_findings.description: The OAM register (www.oam.si) is referenced by ATVP as the free public register of issuers' audited annual and semi-annual reports, but was not fetched or confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as a candidate with low confidence and blocker_type=unverified rather than as a confirmed source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If live, it may be a better-structured alternative to SEOnet for regulated filings; if defunct or merged into SEOnet/INFO HRAMBA, the pipeline design changes.

negative_findings.description: No distinct Slovene term was found for a machine-readable 'regulated information feed' as a product; the domestic vocabulary is 'nadzorovane informacije', 'objave izdajateljev' and 'INFO hramba', which describe the legal artefact and the storage mechanism rather than a data feed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language searching was performed throughout and produced the authoritative hits; the gap is terminological, not coverage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Future query design should use artefact and mechanism names, not API/feed vocabulary, when searching Slovenian sources.

negative_findings.description: AJPES data re-use (PRS web services, FI-PO/proFI-PO) is tariff-based; the specific price points for a market-intelligence use case were not retrieved, only the existence of the Cenik storitev and new tariffs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Cost of the only scalable legal route to Slovenian annual-report financials is unquantified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget and build-vs-buy decision for the Slovenian A1 leg cannot be closed without it.

coverage_gaps.description: Deep links for the LJSE financial calendar and for per-issuer SEOnet archive pages were not pinned down; only homepage/sitemap entry points are recorded.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://ljse.si/en/sitemap/959 and one issuer instrument page (e.g. ISIN SI0021117344) to map the canonical URL patterns before building the crawler.

coverage_gaps.description: Most Slovenian payment-services firms and POS/IT suppliers to banks are unlisted d.o.o. entities whose only public artefact is the AJPES annual report; there is no press-release or IR stream for them in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with a media/procurement cell; and build the SKD-code-driven entity list (64.19, 64.99, 66.19, 62.01, 62.09, 47.4x) from ePRS/OPSI to make AJPES coverage systematic.

coverage_gaps.description: Free JOLP access covers only the last five business years; longer time series for trend analysis are not obtainable through the public interface.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scope whether five years suffices; if not, price the AJPES bulk/historical channel or accept a commercial aggregator (e.g. Bisnode/Dun & Bradstreet Slovenia) as a fallback — not yet scouted in this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial Slovenian credit/company-data aggregators that resell AJPES filings (bonitete providers) were not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up sweep on 'bonitetna ocena', 'bonitete podjetij', 'AJPES bonitete', 'GVIN', 'Bisnode Slovenija' to assess the paid aggregator tier.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched to confirm reachability; all entries rest on search-result evidence and observed URL patterns.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass over all example_urls, paying particular attention to oam.si, the bsi.si PDF links and the LJSE UserDocsImages PDF paths (which carry query-string version markers that may rotate).

brief: Slovenia's disclosure infrastructure is unusually centralised: AJPES is the single statutory sink for essentially all corporate annual reports (JOLP), the business and court registers, and official corporate/insolvency announcements (eObjave), while LJSE's SEOnet is the mandated venue for listed-issuer regulated information, backed by the INFO HRAMBA storage mechanism and mirrored on the regulator side by ATVP's registers and the referenced oam.si. For A1 this means two primary ingestion points (AJPES for the unlisted majority, SEOnet for NLB and the handful of listed financial issuers), plus three pointer registers — ePRS/OPSI for SKD-coded entity discovery and Banka Slovenije's register subjektov nadzora for the licensed bank/payment-institution universe. The main constraints are commercial and technical rather than legal: free JOLP access is rate-limited and five years deep, scalable structured financials sit behind the paid FI-PO/ponovna-uporaba tariff, and no public API or RSS was found for SEOnet, so disclosure ingestion will likely need a maintained HTML crawler.
